name: media-11
description: Podcast episode with a sticky player bar and a clickable, auto-highlighting transcript.

"use client" import { useEffect, useState } from "react" import { Pause, Play, Rewind, FastForward } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const segments = [ { at: 0, speaker: "Ada", text: "Welcome back to Small Batch, the show about people who build things slowly on purpose. I'm Ada." }, { at: 9, speaker: "Ada", text: "Today I'm with Rafael, who has been running a two-person bicycle frame shop for eleven years." }, { at: 18, speaker: "Rafael", text: "Thanks for having me. Eleven and a half, technically, but who's counting." }, { at: 25, speaker: "Ada", text: "Let's start with the waitlist. You have, what, fourteen months of orders?" }, { at: 32, speaker: "Rafael", text: "Sixteen now. And honestly the waitlist is the hardest part of the business, not the welding." }, { at: 42, speaker: "Rafael", text: "People are paying for something they won't touch for over a year. That's an enormous amount of trust." }, { at: 52, speaker: "Ada", text: "So how do you keep that trust alive for sixteen months?" }, { at: 58, speaker: "Rafael", text: "A photo every month. Their tubes arriving, the mitres, the first tack weld. It costs me an hour a week." }, ] const DURATION = 70 const fmt = (s: number) => `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(s) % 60).padStart(2, "0")}` export default function Media11() { const [time, setTime] = useState(18) const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false) useEffect(() => { if (!playing) return const id = setInterval(() => setTime((t) => (t + 1 > DURATION ? 0 : t + 1)), 1000) return () => clearInterval(id) }, [playing]) const activeIndex = segments.reduce((acc, s, i) => (time >= s.at ? i : acc), 0) return (
